name: scula-lu-miron-tests
description: Ad-hoc Playwright checks for editor.html, recipes.html, index.html and voice.html (see README.md). Not part of the apps themselves - see the root CLAUDE.md for why the apps stay dependency-free.

scripts.test: for f in flow stuck gestures stress regression desktop extras withimage infinite undoredo spline spline-touch polyline recipes graph find nav wbrename wbsaveall wbtodo paste voice dictate; do node $f.js || exit 1; done
